subject: learning/localfs-index-work-tests
statement: Localfs store reads use per-store functions initialized to the same os.ReadFile and os.ReadDir operations. The hierarchy test observes actual reads for eight children with 100 and 10000 unrelated items, checks the returned child IDs, and rejects a full-store scan. Capacity query tests retain expected result counts and record latency as advisory samples in every build mode.
intent: Protect indexed lookup complexity and query correctness without treating host latency as a correctness predicate.
rationale: A fast full scan can pass a latency threshold and a correct indexed query can fail on a busy host. Counting filesystem work tests the access-path requirement directly; AP-29 makes environment-dependent measurements advisory.
